IRS990.Desc: Provide support to CDLC (Casa de las Campanas, INC.) in furtherance of their exempt organization purpose in enhancing the life of older persons through innovative and socially responsible programs. Within this framework as a Foundation, it receives various donor restricted funds to support and promote the charitable nature of CDLC,which may include employee scholarships, health care, activities, resident hardships, music, transportion, employee assistance, art collection and other restrictions.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Art collection is displayed throughout the facility for
Various endowments for healthcare, transportation, activities, hardships, scholarships for non-profit programs.

Casa de las Campanas & the Foundation are exempt from Federal & California income taxes under section 501 (c) (3) of the IRC & corresponding California provisions, except to the extend UBIT as defined by the IRC. Casa & the Foundation maintain their tax-exempt status through devoting their resources to meet the primary needs of aged persons, housing, health care & financial security. The organization evaluates uncertain tax positions through its review of the sources of income to identify UBTI & certain other matters, including those which may affect its tax exempt status. The effect of the uncertainty would be recorded if the outcome was considered probable and reasonably estimatable. As of July 31, 2024 & 2023, the organization had no uncertain tax positions requiring accrual.

The Foundation Board approves an annual budget prior to the beginning of the fiscal year. Any non-budgeted general support expenditures greater than $5,000 are approved by the Foundation Board. In addition, an advisory committee reviews the financial reports. Records are maintained to substantiate all activities that are subject to an annual audit.

Part II on the previous page relates to Casa de las Campanas, a related organization. Kim Dominy is an employee of Life Care Services, the management company, and serves as the Executive Director at Casa de las Campanas, a key employee.
Incentive bonus compensation for the related organization was partially based on the related organization net operating income.
The 990 is shared with the Board of Directors at a Board meeting prior to filing with brief review and question & answer session.
Annually the Board completes a conflict of interest form.
